structure_assets.description: Main Figure 1: source SEM of NP5 QD/Ag assembly, 50 nm scale bar, plus optical panels; Figure 1a is an authored source schematic. Publisher permission unverified.
Measured SEM panel 1b for NP5 with original 50 nm scale bar; distinct from the full mixed schematic/optical Figure 1. Publisher permission unverified.
SI Figure 6 includes SEM insets of NP1–NP5 and measured scattering spectra. Composite supports all five products; see source caption. Publisher permission unverified.
Original explanatory diagram of QD film transfer and Ag nanoprism deposition, not a measured micrograph.

Main Figure 2: panel a measured NP5 scattering and PLE enhancement; panels b/c overlay measured scattering with FDTD calculations. Mixed measured/model graphic, not an atomic structure or additional sample. Publisher permission unverified.

quality.review_scope: Independent scoped quick audit accepted the main PDF pp.1-4 QD-film/Ag-nanoprism assembly and NP1-NP5 observations, Figures 1-2 and Table 1, plus essential SI pp.1-2, 5, 13-14. Upstream QD/Ag-prism syntheses remain cited inputs, not reconstructed routes; the separate glass-slide QY reference is not the NP5 ITO film.
missing_fields: No in-paper QD core/multishell synthesis or Ag nanoprism core synthesis.
Ag drop volume, dilution solvent and optical-density wavelength/path length are not reported.
Exact LB pressure, aliquot and withdrawal speed for NP1–NP5 individually are not assigned; only a study-wide range.
QD core/shell dimensions, prism thickness, phase, atomic coordinates and ligand identities are not specimen-measured in this scope.
Relative order of the 10 min QD photoanneal and Ag prism deposition is not specified; both are completed before optical study.
